findings.where: hero right column, three div.floaty cards ('Your goal', 'Recommended stack', 'Workflow')
findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: animation 'floaty' 7s (translateY 0 to -14px) on three text-bearing cards; CSS keyframes loop with no pause control. A prefers-reduced-motion override exists, so this is 2.2.2 only, not 2.3.3.
findings.after: Stop after one or two cycles (animation-iteration-count: 2) or add a visible pause toggle; keep the existing reduced-motion override
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide: content that moves for more than 5 seconds alongside other content needs a way to pause it.

findings.where: goal card grid, third card 'Create content' at 1440
findings.evidence: focus.json stop 13 ('CONTENT Create content...') is covered=true: the fixed 'Edit with Lovable' badge (bottom right, tile 1440-00) sits over the card when it receives focus. Confirms sweep focus_ring hit.
findings.after: Remove the builder badge from production, or add scroll-padding-bottom equal to its height so focused items scroll clear

findings.where: AI Tools Directory, six 'View details' links
findings.evidence: focus.json stops 23-28 all have the accessible name 'View details'; out of context a screen-reader links list shows six identical entries.
findings.after: View details or visually hidden text: 'View details for Claude'
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context) passes via card context, but 2.4.9 and links-list navigation fail; cheap to fix.

findings.evidence: Two plain <button type=button> elements 'USD' and 'INR'; the selected currency is shown only by a black pill fill (tile 1440-00). dom-1440.json records no role or pressed state on either.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value: the selected state must be programmatically exposed. (Capture does not list aria-pressed; confirm in source.)

findings.evidence: First focusable is the logo link 'AAI Stack' (the 'A' logo glyph text is read into the name, so it announces 'A AI Stack').
findings.after: aria-hidden="true" on the 'A' logo tile; add a skip link to #main as the first focusable
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks and 2.5.3 Label in Name (stray 'A' in the accessible name).

strengths: Landmarks present (header, nav, main, footer), one h1, headings step h1 > h2 > h3 cleanly.
Visible focus outline on every stop in focus.json; mobile menu button has a name ('Open menu').
Comparison is a real <table> with header row.
